name: Hatsune Miku: VR Future Live Season Pass
summary:
This is the season pass for Hatsune MIku: VR Future Live. Includes all three stages!

Experience the Hatsune Miku concert of the future! Enter a virtual stadium, immerse yourself in the audience, and get lost in the music. And if the crowd goes really wild, you'll even get the chance to watch a special, one-on-one performance. So raise your glow sticks, cheer Miku on, and enjoy the show like never before!
